fields.description: Central's code for the region, e.g. blr1.
fields.label: Region

fields.description: Central's name for the region, e.g. Mumbai. Set by Sync Regions.
fields.label: Display Name

fields.description: The cloud the region runs on, as Central reports it. Set by Sync Regions.
fields.label: Provider

fields.description: Country the region is in, e.g. IN. Set by Sync Regions.
fields.label: Country Code

fields.description: Suite Cloud keeps sites and servers here. Set by hand; Sync Regions never changes it.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: The region's status on Central; only Active regions are listed. Set by Sync Regions.
fields.label: Central Status

fields.description: Central could reach the region's infrastructure when it was last synced.
fields.label: Reachable

fields.description: The zone Central's proxy serves this region's sites under: the region code followed by Central's wildcard domain, e.g. blr1.frappe.cloud. Learned from the first server set up here; every later server must report the same zone.
fields.label: Proxy Zone

fields.description: Region code a Stalwart Cluster lists for this region, e.g. blr. Picks the mail cluster of tenants placed here; blank uses the region code, and a code no cluster lists sends them to the default cluster.
fields.label: Stalwart Region

fields.description: When Sync Regions last read this region from Central. It runs daily and from Suite Cloud Settings.
fields.label: Last Synced At
